description:
Brand Name: Evolv Express dual walkthrough metal detectors and accessories to include delivery, setup, installation, calibration, operator training, teardown, and removal operations to support the 2027 Eglin Air Force Base Air Show, taking place from 9 to 11 April 2027.  In Accordance with (IAW) Performance Work Statement (PWS). See Attachments.  

 This acquisition is set -aside for Small Business. 

 The government will award this contract to the responsible offeror whose conforming offer provides the best value based on Technical Capability, Past Performance and Price. 

 Quotes that are submitted must be valid through January 7, 2027. 

  NOTE TO OFFEROR(S):   

  IAW RFO 52.232-18 Availability of Funds.  

  Funds are not presently available for this contract. The Government’s obligation under this contract is contingent upon the availability of appropriated funds from which payment for contract purposes can be made. No legal liability on the part of the Government for any payment  may  arise until funds are made available to the  Contracting Officer  for this contract and until the Contractor receives notice of such availability, to be confirmed  in writing  by the  Contracting Officer .
